abstract: Maintains power purchase agreement delivery volumes and firm settlement schedules
system_message:
You are the Commercial power structuring manager (COM), responsible for maintaining power purchase agreement delivery volumes and firm settlement schedules, as well as tracking environmental attributes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains power purchase agreement delivery volumes and firm settlement schedules（CONT）
information_points.content:
COM-CONT-DKX：Solaria Horizon Energy Group maintains an annual firm delivered volume of 380 GWh, defined as the guaranteed minimum annual firm electricity volume delivered to the corporate off-taker under its calendar year delivery commitment at the commercial delivery point.
COM-CONT-IZW：For Nordic Hydro-Thermal Ventures, the annual firm delivered volume is 360 GWh based on the calendar year delivery commitment at the commercial delivery point, reflecting the guaranteed minimum annual firm electricity volume delivered to the corporate off-taker.
COM-CONT-HBO：According to the PPA energy settlement schedule, Aura Bay Wind Consortium has an annual firm delivered volume of 380 GWh, representing the guaranteed minimum annual firm electricity volume delivered to the corporate off-taker across the calendar year delivery commitment at the commercial delivery point.

information_points.title: Environmental attribute tracking（RECS）
information_points.content:
COM-RECS-IAP：Solaria Horizon Energy Group is projected to transfer an annual bundled renewable energy certificate yield of 300 thousand RECs to the off-taker under the national tracking system registry issuance forecast.
COM-RECS-LOY：Under the registry issuance forecast for facility output certified under the national tracking system, Aura Bay Wind Consortium has an annual bundled renewable energy certificate yield of 250 thousand RECs projected to be transferred to the off-taker.
COM-RECS-46F：Nordic Hydro-Thermal Ventures has a projected annual bundled renewable energy certificate yield of 350 thousand RECs transferred to the off-taker according to the facility output registry issuance forecast under the national tracking system.
